event_records.description: Aldergate Rail's management is aware of the signaling-contract delay and is considering whether to issue a market warning before the scheduled interim results day.

aldergate_rail.name: Aldergate Rail
aldergate_rail.persona_brief:
You are Aldergate Rail.
Aldergate Rail is a listed firm. It has a signaling-contract delay that may be material to the market. It has not yet decided whether to issue a warning before its scheduled interim results day on November 5. The board and management are aware of the delay and its potential impact.

resolution.question: Will the listed firm Aldergate Rail warn the market about its signaling-contract delay before its scheduled interim results day on November 5?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, before the hard cutoff at 2026-11-05T07:00:00+00:00, Aldergate Rail issues a public warning to the market about the signaling-contract delay (e.g., via a regulatory filing, press release, or stock exchange announcement). Otherwise resolve NO.
